localizedDescriptions.en: Inspect Render services, deployments, and operational logs in your workspace.
localizedDescriptions.zh-CN: 检查 Render 工作区的服务、部署和运行日志。

en: In my Render workspace, show the latest deployment status for each web service.
zh-CN: 查看我的 Render 工作区中每个 Web 服务最近一次部署的状态。

instructions.en: Create an API key in Render Account Settings and enter it in the plugin settings. After connecting, tell the assistant which Render workspace to use.
instructions.zh-CN: 在 Render 账号设置中创建 API Key，再填入插件设置。连接后，请告知助手要使用的 Render 工作区。
